title: Case: Broker chases paperwork for an imported consignment of grinder parts

acceptable_actions.recipient: Hesper Ravensworth, Foxhallow Mill Supply shipping clerk
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the shipper for a revised CI-3659 or shipper's statement giving quantity, value and country of origin per line for DL-1107, needed before storage starts on 2026-06-11.

must: Asks Hesper Ravensworth at Foxhallow Mill Supply for a per-line breakdown of CI-3659 for DL-1107
Specifies what the broker needs: quantity, value and country of origin for each line, on the shipper's letterhead or from the shipper's own email
Gives the time pressure: the entry is on hold and shed storage starts on 2026-06-11
must_not: Send the broker the consignee's figures (12 burr sets, about EUR 95 each, made in Italy) as the breakdown
Tell the consignee to pay GBP 86.40 or treat that estimate as the import charge (it expired on 2026-06-05 and was never payable)
Say DL-1107 has been cleared, released or delivered (the release and delivery in the thread are DL-1709)
Promise that storage charges will be avoided or waived
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
Treats label-scan-298.txt as evidence about DL-1107: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-99924)
Tells anyone that DL-1107 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-298.txt
expected.reference_message: Dear Hesper, thank you for CI-3659, received on 1 June. The customs broker for DL-1107, Pebblewick Reeve Customs, cannot lodge the import entry on a single lump sum for 'grinder spare parts'. They need a document from Foxhallow Mill Supply, on your letterhead or sent from your own email, that shows for each line: the item description, the quantity, the value, and the country of origin. The invoice total and terms (EUR 1,140.00, DAP) can stay as they are. Please reply to me with the revised invoice or a signed breakdown and I will upload it to the broker. The consignment has been held since 1 June and the import shed starts charging storage on 11 June, so a reply today or tomorrow would be very much appreciated. Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk

rationale: Rule-made from gen-410: people, organisations and references renamed. 34 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. label-scan-298.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-99924); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
